    Where did Brad Brownell coach before Clemson?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    Before becoming the head coach at Clemson in 2010, Brad Brownell was the head coach at Wright State (2006–2010) and UNC Wilmington (2002–2006). He also served as an assistant coach at UNC Wilmington (1994–2002), the University of Indianapolis, and Evansville. 
    Key Coaching Stints Before Clemson: 
    • Wright State (2006–2010): Compiled an 84-45 record, including a 2007 NCAA Tournament appearance.
    • UNC Wilmington (2002–2006): Went 83-40 over four seasons, leading the Seahawks to two NCAA Tournaments (2003, 2006). 
    Brownell is recognized for building successful programs at the mid-major level before moving to the ACC.
